scope.construct: method sensitivity of surface lexical amount, variety, and repetition

tokenizer.unit: ASCII alphabetic word with internal straight or curly apostrophes

metrics.types: number of distinct normalized tokenizer units
metrics.type_token_ratio: types divided by tokens; zero when tokens is zero
metrics.hapax_types: number of normalized types occurring exactly once

fergadiotis-wright-green-2015.citation: Fergadiotis, G., Wright, H. H., & Green, S. B. (2015). Psychometric evaluation of lexical diversity indices: Assessing length effects. Journal of Speech, Language, and Hearing Research, 58(3), 840–852.
fergadiotis-wright-green-2015.supports_ja: TTRの標本長による交絡と、構成概念妥当性を実装一致から推定できないという解釈境界。

zenker-kyle-2021.citation: Zenker, F., & Kyle, K. (2021). Investigating minimum text lengths for lexical diversity indices. Assessing Writing, 47, 100505.
zenker-kyle-2021.supports_ja: 単純TTRの定義と、当該L2論証エッセイ標本の50–200 token範囲で観測された長さ依存性。

reference_scope: The references support the stated TTR definition and interpretation limits; they do not validate this application, its tokenizer, bundled scenarios, or any population inference.
limitations: type_token_ratio is length-sensitive and is not a cross-text quality score
with both texts fixed at 100 tokens, type_token_ratio is exactly types divided by 100 and is not independent evidence
sentence punctuation is discarded, so segmentation-only changes are invariant by design for every displayed metric
the nested-length scenario changes both sample size and accumulated lexical composition and does not identify a sentence-count effect
the bundled pair controls token count and sentence frames but not lexical frequency, semantics, familiarity, or naturalness
the visible contrast was deliberately engineered and is not an effect estimate for naturally occurring text

the workspace supports one text, researcher-declared line units, a descriptive two-text difference, or a descriptive document batch and provides no automatic sentence-level group-level or inferential analysis
declared-segment mode treats non-empty lines as researcher-declared units and does not perform automatic sentence segmentation
declared segments within one text are not independent authors participants or population observations
documents in a batch are not assumed to be independent participants and the unweighted distribution is not a population estimate
the rights attestation is supplied by the researcher and is not independently verified by the application
the SHA-256 identifies the analyzed UTF-8 string but is not anonymization and the metadata-only export cannot reproduce a result without the separately preserved source text
the exported hash and client-clock timestamp are not a signature proof of authorship or trusted proof of when analysis occurred and the JSON can be edited after export
implementation parity does not establish construct validity

presentation.comparison_direction: second sample minus first sample within the selected scenario

relationship_meanings.single: one declared text span; no difference
relationship_meanings.declared-segments: one text containing two or more researcher-declared non-empty line units; no between-participant inference
relationship_meanings.paired: two deliberately related texts; second minus first
relationship_meanings.independent: two separately sampled texts; descriptive second-minus-first difference only
relationship_meanings.batch: two to one hundred researcher-identified documents; per-document values and unweighted descriptive distribution only

workspace.input_identifier: trimmed case-sensitive id unique within each exported record
workspace.record_timestamp: required exact Date.toISOString UTC string from the client clock; not a trusted timestamp signature or evidence of analysis time
workspace.metadata_normalization: trim leading and trailing whitespace from id label provenance and sampling/comparison design; preserve text exactly
workspace.unicode_validation: reject strings containing unpaired UTF-16 surrogates before UTF-8 hashing or export; requires String.prototype.isWellFormed
workspace.declared_segment_rule: split exact input at LF or CRLF; ignore whitespace-only lines; preserve non-empty line order; do not infer sentences
workspace.declared_segment_summary: unweighted minimum median and maximum across declared lines; even-count median is the arithmetic mean of the two middle values; descriptive only
workspace.batch_input: JSON array of objects with unique id label provenance and text strings; preserve array order; all-or-nothing validation
workspace.batch_summary: unweighted minimum median and maximum across documents; no pooled score groups ranking or inference

warning_meanings_ja.descriptive-only: 表示値は入力テキストと指定手続きの記述であり、評価・診断・統計推測ではない。
warning_meanings_ja.ttr-length-sensitive: TTRは標本長に依存するため、長さの異なるテキストを単純順位化できない。
warning_meanings_ja.no-recognized-tokens: 現在のASCII英語tokenizerが認識したtokenが0件の入力を含む。
warning_meanings_ja.researcher-declared-segments: 各単位は自動文分割ではなく、研究者が改行で宣言した非空行である。
warning_meanings_ja.segments-not-independent-observations: 同一テキスト内の行を独立した著者・参加者・母集団標本として扱えない。
warning_meanings_ja.pooled-and-segment-statistics-not-equiva: 全文をpoolした値と行別値の分布・平均は異なる量であり、置き換えられない。
warning_meanings_ja.batch-documents-not-independent: バッチ内の文書を独立した参加者・母集団標本とは仮定していない。依存関係は設計メモで管理する必要がある。
warning_meanings_ja.batch-summary-unweighted: 文書別分布は各文書を1行として等しく数えた記述値であり、pool値・順位・母集団推定ではない。
warning_meanings_ja.types-and-ttr-algebraically-dependent-at: 同じtoken数ではTypes差とTTR差は代数的に従属し、独立した証拠ではない。
warning_meanings_ja.cross-length-difference-confounded: token数が異なるため、TTR差には長さと語彙構成が同時に関与する。
warning_meanings_ja.independent-texts-not-causal: 独立した2テキストの差だけでは、母集団差や因果効果を推論できない。

retention.user_source: live form memory only; application performs no durable write
retention.clear_control: explicit reset and best-effort pagehide reset; browser or device memory/history erasure is not guaranteed
